projects.title: Aethel Luxury Botanics
projects.description: A monolithic luxury botanical identity, bespoke packaging architecture, and typography system for an ultra-clean Swiss skincare formulation.

caseStudy.overview: Aethel required a transformative rebrand to position its bio-fermented skincare line in high-end European department stores.
caseStudy.challenge: The existing branding felt sterile and medicinal, failing to communicate both organic alchemy and luxury price points.
caseStudy.solution: We engineered an understated editorial identity pairing serif typography with tactile textured packaging in forest and cream tones.
results: Over $1.2M in pre-orders within 14 days of launch
Featured in Vogue Scandinavia
Retail placement across 18 flagship stores

projects.title: Delvix Intelligent Logistics

Attracted ultra-high-net-worth commissions across 4 countries

Expanded distribution to Japan and South Korea

projects.title: Stride Athletics & Performance

caseStudy.overview: Stride wanted a hyper-kinetic identity for running athletes and high-intensity fitness communities.

Over 400,000 active runners wearing the brand in UK/EU

projects.title: Kura Artisanal Coffee Roasters

Named Best Cafe Packaging 2025 by Sprudge

projects.title: Beaver AI Social Co-Pilot

caseStudy.overview: Beaver needed a next-generation UI/UX and high-performance web app for creator marketing teams managing multiple brands.

Average session length increased by 44%

Ranked #3 Education App on App Store

App Store rating of 4.9/5.0 across 18,000+ reviews

projects.title: ApexMetrics Analytics OS

Adopted by 140+ tech enterprises

Product Hunt Product of the Day

results: Over 85,000 successful consultations conducted
Patient satisfaction rating of 99.1%
